summary: A candidate who is ruled short can contest the clerk's ruling or fall back to the days left to cure.
realLife: A council candidate planned to challenge the city clerk's finding that she was seven signatures short.
sources: Corrales Comment, city council candidate to challenge ballot ruling after falling short by seven signatures: https://corralescomment.com/2025/07/11/city-council-candidate-to-challenge-ballot-ruling-after-falling-short-by-seven-signatures/
inGame: needs: a challenge or cure step after a short petition; the clerk's check exists, a formal contest does not

turns.turn: The candidate accepts the ruling and drops out
turns.writes: a withdrawal and a family talk

turns.turn: The candidate cures it in the days left
turns.writes: a second canvass and a late filing
